scientific_limitations: The model has instantaneous rate-r Poisson resets to the initial position, persistent endpoint-detection memory, one-dimensional reflected diffusion and fixed positive L,D,r.
The claimed tail optimum concerns the exponential long-time survival rate and does not imply stochastic ordering for all finite times.
The exact all-location mean expression is already in Linn and Lawley; the assessed contribution is the complete optimizer phase diagram plus the universally opposite long-time tail optimum.
title: Exact mean–tail reset-location conflict in Brownian interval coverage
